title: Ad-Tech-Stack-Extractor Input
description: Raw HTML source, DOM fragment, JavaScript snippet, or HTTP response headers to scan for ad tech technology fingerprints.

source.description: Raw input string. May be: full HTML page source, a <head> or <body> fragment, inline or external JavaScript blocks, HTTP response header text, or any combination. Passed verbatim — no preprocessing required.

notes: The input may be passed as a raw string prompt prefix (e.g. 'Extract from: <html>...') — the skill handles both structured JSON and freeform prompt formats.
Headers may be passed as raw text blocks (e.g. 'Set-Cookie: ...\nX-Powered-By: ...').
Minified or obfuscated JavaScript is accepted; pattern matching operates on raw string content.
